summary: Iteration 7 validates the field-tester Message-241 batch: admin dashboard (/api/admin/overview + /admin PIN gate), 4th survey category 'Lieux sacrés et lieux touristiques' (heritage), community/remote PUBLIC address detail (blank-screen bugfix), back-button state preservation, 'Lieux fréquentés' per person, draft save/resume, compass instruction on step 3 and GPS-correction CTAs on step 4. BACKEND: 13/13 new tests in test_efyl_v4_batch7.py PASS on the public preview URL; full suite is 70/70 (57 prior + 13 new). Admin PIN gate rejects wrong/missing PIN (401/403/422) and returns full by_type with 4 categories including heritage. Heritage survey with survey_type='heritage' correctly propagates is_heritage=true on the address, surfaces on /commerces community feed AND cross-user via /addresses. GET /api/addresses/{id} falls back to any-owner when owner_id is missing/mismatched — this is the endpoint used by the mobile 'remote community detail' fetch that previously produced a blank screen. Admin CSV export includes heritage_* columns (heritage_name, heritage_kind, heritage_category, heritage_access, heritage_entry_fee, heritage_photos_allowed, heritage_road_access) and persons_places column. FRONTEND (Expo web, 390x844): /admin PIN gate → wrong PIN shows 'Code incorrect' + backend 403; correct PIN 237237 reveals admin-dashboard with 6 stat cards (stat-total=7, stat-today, stat-week=4, stat-active, stat-surveys=1, stat-persons=0), 4-row by_type breakdown (Foyers 6, Commerces 0, Services publics 1, Lieux sacrés / touristiques 0), tester cards for guest & tester1, admin-export-btn present. Community remote PUBLIC address detail /address/TEST-PUB-001-001 (owned by 'tester1') now renders correctly under guest mode: address-detail-screen + community-badge + detail-code='TEST-PUB-001-001' + leaflet map + GPS coords + Photos section — NO blank screen. Heritage survey wizard: type-choice-heritage card visible, step-heritage renders, all chips present (her-kind-both, her-cat-chiefdom, her-access-paid revealing her-fee input, her-photos-yes, her-road-good), summary shows 'Lieu sacré / touristique • Chefferie Test • Accès payant — 1000 FCFA'. Back button (Retour) preserves answers: entered 'Nkomo TEST' on familyName step, advanced 2 steps, pressed Retour twice, value 'Nkomo TEST' still in family-name-input. Draft save/resume: survey-draft-btn present, tapping it saves draft to localStorage 'efyl:survey_drafts', reopening survey shows draft-resumed-banner ('Reprise de votre enquête en cours') and lands on saved step (Question 5/21 for income) with all prior answers intact. Frequented places per person: all 5 category chips (pp-cat-shop/work/school/leisure/friend), pp-name, all 4 frequency chips (pp-freq-daily/weekly/monthly/rarely), pp-reason, pp-add-btn all present and functional — added place appears as place-card-0 with place-delete-0. New-address step 3 compass card renders 'Placez-vous dehors, face à l'entrée. Tenez le téléphone à plat à hauteur de poitrine, le HAUT du téléphone pointé vers la porte…' via t.newAddress.compassInstruction; step 4 CTA default label is 'Continuer sans corriger' (latCorrected===null) and toggles to 'Enregistrer et continuer' after pin drag (verified in source at new-address.tsx:721). pub-cat-other testID collision from iteration 6 is FIXED — TextInput now uses pub-cat-other-input (survey/[id].tsx:704) and her-cat-other-input (:750). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) present in package.json.

react_native_issues.issue: Persistent RN Web deprecation warnings unchanged from iteration 6: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' deprecated (use textShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), Animated: useNativeDriver JS-fallback warning. Not caused by this batch — pre-existing across the app. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/index.ts (Shadows tokens).

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/survey/[id].tsx is now 1177 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. High-priority refactor candidate: extract 4 step-order components (HouseholdSteps, CommerceStep, PublicStep, HeritageStep) + PersonForm + PlacesEditor into /app/frontend/src/components/survey/. This will also make the ORDER + validate() switch statements smaller and easier to maintain.

The /api/admin/overview endpoint iterates every address in the DB in-Python (line 728-762 of server.py). At field-scale (~10k addresses) this becomes slow and memory-heavy. Consider migrating to a single Mongo aggregation with $group by owner_id + $facet for by_type + $match by created_at bucket.

The blank-screen fix relies on GET /api/addresses/{id} silently falling back to any-owner if the owner-scoped lookup returns nothing (server.py:349-360). This works but leaks the entire address (including notes, contact_phone, etc.) to any client that guesses an address_id — even PRIVATE households, not just is_public/is_commerce/is_heritage. Recommend the fallback branch add `... {'is_commerce':True,'is_public':True,'is_heritage':True} OR match owner_id` to prevent private household leakage. Reference: server.py:349-360.

Admin endpoints authenticate solely via ?pin=237237 query param — PIN travels in URL (logged in access logs, browser history, CDN). Move to Authorization: Bearer header + optional short-lived JWT for production. Currently OK for internal beta but flag for public release.

Draft resume path in /app/frontend/app/survey/[id].tsx:65-88 restores the draft with `setTypeChosen(true)` unconditionally — if a draft was saved on 'typeChoice' step, the user cannot re-pick a different survey type on resume because the type-cards branch is gated by typeChosen. Rare but possible edge case.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public backend base = https://efyl-address-book.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Admin PIN = 237237 (env ADMIN_PIN). Survey draft localStorage key = 'efyl:survey_drafts' → map keyed by address_id → { survey, stepKey, savedAt }. HERITAGE_ORDER = ['typeChoice','heritage','summary'] (short flow — one big form step, then summary). PUBLIC_ORDER = ['typeChoice','publicService','summary']. HOUSEHOLD_ORDER has 21 steps; personEntry appears at index 19 and requires all prior validation to pass — for automated tests, seed a localStorage draft {stepKey:'personEntry'} to jump to that step in one hop. Heritage testIDs on survey step: her-name, her-kind-{sacred|tourist|both}, her-cat-{chiefdom|sacred_forest|worship|tomb|waterfall|cave|museum|monument|viewpoint|craft_market|other}, her-cat-other-input, her-desc, her-manager, her-access-{free|paid|permission}, her-fee (conditional on access=paid), her-hours, her-period, her-photos-yes/no, her-restrictions, her-fac-{k} (facilities), her-road-{good|average|difficult}, her-phone, her-notes. Admin screen testIDs: admin-pin-input, admin-pin-submit, admin-dashboard, admin-back, admin-lock, stat-total/today/week/active/surveys/persons, admin-user-{owner_id}, admin-export-btn, admin-addr-{address_id}. Blank-screen bugfix root cause: /app/frontend/app/address/[id].tsx now falls back to Api.getAddress(decoded) when the address is not on this device (line 44) and Api.getAddress calls GET /api/addresses/{id} without owner_id → server.py:349-360 fallback returns the address regardless of owner.
rca_of_issue: Community 'Fotouni TEST-PUB' blank-screen RCA: pre-fix the address detail screen only queried local Storage.getAddresses() for the requested address_id; a public address created by another surveyor was surfaced in the home 'community' feed via the /api/addresses `include_public_commerces` merge, but tapping it navigated to /address/[id] which found no local record → set addr=null → rendered a null/blank screen (no not-found placeholder was reached because the loader guard set addr to a truthy default in the old code path). Fix: /app/frontend/app/address/[id].tsx:30-51 now (1) tries local, (2) on miss calls Api.getAddress(decoded) → GET /api/addresses/{id}, (3) sets isRemote=true so UI shows the read-only community banner and hides the delete button. Server-side, /api/addresses/{id} already had a fallback (server.py:355) that returns the address by address_id alone when the owner-scoped find_one returns nothing. Validated end-to-end: /address/TEST-PUB-001-001 renders correctly under guest mode with community-badge + map + GPS. Minor concern flagged in critical_code_review_comments #3: the fallback also exposes private households, not just public ones — should be tightened with an is_public/is_commerce/is_heritage guard.
